summary: You pick the self-designed path or one of the four tracks. Every course must be taken for a letter grade unless it is only offered S/NC, the core courses need a B or better and every other course a C or better, and each course counts toward one component only. On the self-designed path the audit checks 10 units of core courses, Methods & Skills, Theory, and 10 elective units from any of the emphasis lists; a non-ARCHLGY elective the curriculum committee approves is moved in by hand. The tracks have no Bulletin text beyond their course lists and are checked as listed.

program.why: Grading: "All courses must be taken for a letter grade, unless only offered S/NC. Core courses require a minimum grade of B. All other program requirements require a minimum grade of C."

Q4OOXeui-text.why: "To minor in Archaeology, students must complete at least 27 units of relevant coursework comprised of: Core | 10 Units, Methods & Skills | 2-5 Units, Theory | 5 Units, Electives | 10 Units". An overview: the 27 units are the program minimum, each component is its own rule on the self-designed path, and the tracks and emphasis categories are described, not required.

ynH5Jvus.why: "Select any combination of the core courses to complete the 10-unit requirement. All courses must be taken for a letter grade and have a minimum passing grade of B."

cbxRGXfP.why: "Students must complete 10 units of Electives on regions, themes, or other areas of interest ... students may choose courses from multiple emphasis categories."
